title: Methodist Church built 1894, Forester Hall, MacIntosh home
description: The first service of the Methodist Church, later known as the United Church, was held on November 17, 1873, in Matheson Hall on Upper Main Street. As the congregation grew, a new church was constructed in 1894 under the leadership of Rev. H. S. Young. The cornerstone was laid on July 11, and the church was dedicated on October 7. Today, Trinity United Church of Canada is recognized as a Local Historic Place for its architectural significance and its lasting religious and cultural impact.
